jobs.occupation: Sales, Administration and Marketing Apprentice (2-Year Program)
jobs.description:
Automobility-X is a growing company based in Ikast, Denmark, specializing in mobility and vehicle solutions. We work with customers and suppliers across Europe and beyond, giving you the opportunity to gain valuable international experience. As part of our small team, you will work across different areas of the business and take on real responsibility from day one.

We are looking for a motivated and proactive Sales, Administration and Marketing Apprentice who is eager to develop practical skills in sales, administration, marketing, and international trade.

About the apprenticeship

This is a full-time, 2-year apprenticeship (approximately 37 hours per week). During the program, you will receive thorough training and work closely with experienced colleagues who will support your development.

You will be involved in the company's daily operations, communicate with customers and suppliers from around the world, and gain practical experience in an international business environment. For the right candidate, the apprenticeship may lead to a permanent position after completion.

Your responsibilities

• Preparing and following up on quotations 

• Processing customer orders and coordinating deliveries 

• Communicating with customers and suppliers 

• Administrative tasks and invoicing 

• Supporting marketing activities and social media 

• Maintaining product documentation and internal systems 

• Assisting with various ad hoc tasks 

We are looking for someone who

• Is positive, motivated, and enjoys working with people 

• Has an interest in sales, administration, and business 

• Is well organized and takes responsibility for their work 

• Enjoys working in a team and communicating with customers 

• Can manage several tasks in a fast-paced environment 

• Has good English skills (an additional language is an advantage) 

• Is familiar with Microsoft Office 

• Is eager to learn and ready to take on new challenges 

What we offer

• A varied and exciting 2-year apprenticeship 

• Responsibility from the beginning and the opportunity to make an impact 

• An international working environment with customers and suppliers worldwide 

• Close collaboration with experienced colleagues 

• Professional and personal development throughout the apprenticeship 

• Hands-on experience in sales, administration, marketing, logistics, and international trade 

• The possibility of permanent employment after successfully completing the apprenticeship 

Location: Automobility-X ApS, Thrigesvej 37E, 7430 Ikast, Denmark

Start date: By agreement

How to apply:

Please send your CV and a short motivational letter in English or Danish to zofie@am-x.dk. We would like to learn more about you, why you are interested in joining Automobility-X, and what motivates you.

We value genuine, personal applications over generic or AI-generated submissions.

Questions?

If you have any questions about the apprenticeship or the application process, please contact:

Zofie Jarosova, Operations Manager zofie@am-x.dk, +45 5239 344

Are you passionate about improving business performance and helping a growing company succeed?

We are looking for a structured and business-oriented Business Operations Coordinator to help optimize our operations, improve financial performance, and enhance the customer experience across our nail salon locations.

You will work closely with the owner as a trusted business partner and play an important role in the company's continued growth and development.

• 
Analyze the company's financial performance, key metrics, and KPIs.

• 
Prepare weekly and monthly management reports for the owner.

• 
Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.

• 
Optimize workflows and implement efficient operational processes.

• 
Ensure consistent service quality and an excellent customer experience across all salon locations.

• 
Contribute to the development and strengthening of the company's brand.

•

• 
Work closely with salon managers to ensure efficient day-to-day operations.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Has experience in business operations, operations management, or project management.

• 
Possesses strong analytical, financial, and reporting skills.

• 
Is highly organized with excellent planning and coordination abilities.

• 
Is proactive, solution-oriented, and able to identify opportunities for improvement.

• 
Has excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• 
Is fluent in both Danish and English, spoken and written.

What We Offer

• 
An exciting and varied role with significant influence on the company's development.

• 
The opportunity to make a real impact in a growing business.

• 
Close collaboration with the owner and a fast decision-making environment.

• 
An informal and friendly workplace with dedicated colleagues.

• 
A competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

Application Deadline: As soon as possible.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Therefore, the position may be filled before the application deadline.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.occupation: Cyber Security Consultant (m/f/d) (Cyber-Security-Consultant)
jobs.description:
Do you want to contribute to protecting energy systems of the future and secure OT infrastructure in Renewable Energy? Then apply to become part of an international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.

Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:
Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.
- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.
- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.
- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.
- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.

What you Bring and your Qualities
We expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.

As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

Interested and want to know more?
If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.

PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.
